educationalGoal: In modern society, technological development based on life science is expected.               In modern society, technological development based on life science is expected. In recent years, microorganisms have become widely used in the fields of pharmaceuticals, environmental protection, waste recycling, material production, energy, and food. Students are required to acquire microbial knowledge and related technologies independently. In the Nebaaru project, students can learn the importance of regional collaboration.

              授業の概要および学習上の助言

              The research themes in Project design III are listed below. Students are required to think and act independently. Students will acquire knowledge and techniques for problem solving through PD III activities.

1. Utilization of Bacillus natto (application for industry)
-Tyrisinase inhibitor, LDH inhibitor, Production of Natto, Screening of Bacillus natto
2.Bioethnol production from Komb using marine microorganisms.
